statements.t: We will continue to manage our fixed-cost base in conjunction with our market entry plans and focus our variable spend on marketing, user experience and support and regulatory compliance to become the offering of choice for users and to maintain favorable relationships with regulators.

We also expect to improve our profitability over time as our revenue and gross profit expand as jurisdictions mature, and our variable marketing expenses and fixed costs stabilize or grow at a slower rate.
We expect the number of MUPs to grow as we attract, retain and re-engage users in new and existing jurisdictions and expand our offerings to appeal to a wider audience.
We will continue to evaluate our long-term operating performance and cash needs and believe we are well positioned to continue to fund the operations of our business long-term.

risks.t: our actual results may differ materially from those projected

statements.t: “We are introducing fiscal year 2027 revenue guidance of $7.35 billion to $7.75 billion, an increase of 17% year-over-year at the midpoint, and Adjusted EBITDA guidance of $800 million to $1.0 billion, which includes $300 million of Adjusted EBITDA investment in Predictions at the midpoint.”

• DraftKings is updating its fiscal year 2026 revenue guidance range to $6.35 billion to $6.55 billion and its fiscal year 2026 Adjusted EBITDA guidance range to $175 million to $275 million, primarily reflecting the Company’s increased Adjusted EBITDA investment in Predictions of $650 million to $700 million.

The Company expects fiscal year 2026 Adjusted EBITDA from the core business of $875 million to $925 million, which reflects its decision to invest further in iGaming growth as well as the impact of modestly customer-friendly sport outcomes.
The Company expects Adjusted EBITDA investment in Predictions of $175 million to $225 million in the fourth quarter.

The Company expects fiscal year 2027 revenue from the core business of $6.7 billion to $7.0 billion, an increase of 4% to 9% year-over-year compared to the midpoint of fiscal year 2026 guidance, and Adjusted EBITDA from the core business of $1.15 billion to $1.25 billion.
The Company expects fiscal year 2027 Predictions revenue of $650 million to $750 million and Adjusted EBITDA investment in Predictions of $250 million to $350 million.

A live audio webcast of the earnings conference call will be available on the Company’s website at ir.aboutdraftkings.com, along with a copy of this earnings press release, the Company’s Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q, a third quarter 2026 business update and a slide presentation.
The audio webcast will be available on the Company’s investor relations website until 11:59 p.m.

DraftKings provides a range for its Adjusted EBITDA forecast that it believes will be achieved; however, the Company cannot provide any assurance that it can predict all of the components of the Adjusted EBITDA calculation.
